summary: Frontend testing of Admin > Instagram Promo tab completed. All 3 requested fixes verified working: (1) VERIFIED TALENT badge removed from both Feed and Story designs, (2) Custom images upload UI with checkbox toggle is present and functional, (3) Talent dropdown now shows all 4 approved talents on tab entry. Portfolio images load correctly on talent selection, designs generate with correct branding (BANGALORE FASHION MAGAZINE top-right, BFM logo bottom-left).
passed_tests: Admin login with admin@bangalorefashionmag.com / Admin@123BFM works
Navigation to /admin > Instagram Promo tab works
Talent dropdown shows all 4 approved talents: Test Female Model, Alexandra Singh, Test Store Designer, Test Model (matches expectation)
Selecting talent 'Alexandra Singh' loads talent card with profile image, category, Instagram handle
Portfolio Images (3) loaded and displayed in 4-col grid with Design 1/Design 2 selection buttons
'Use Custom Images' checkbox is present next to Portfolio Images heading
Toggling 'Use Custom Images' ON reveals 'Upload Custom Images' section with + button and 'Upload up to 5 custom images' text
Custom image file input has accept='image/*' attribute
'Generate Instagram Designs' button generates 2 Feed designs + 2 Story designs + Caption + Hashtags
Feed Design 1 and 2 contain NO 'VERIFIED TALENT' badge (0 occurrences in HTML)
Story Design 1 and 2 contain NO 'VERIFIED TALENT' badge (0 occurrences in HTML)
Feed Design top-right shows 'BANGALORE FASHION MAGAZINE' text only
Feed Design bottom-left has BFM logo (verified position: x=16, y=428 in 400x500 container -> bottom-left corner)
Story Design bottom-left has BFM logo (verified position: x=12, y=392 in 250x444 container -> bottom-left corner)
Story Design top shows 'BANGALORE FASHION MAGAZINE' centered header
Download Feed/Story buttons present for each design
Caption and Hashtags text areas populated with copy buttons
Regenerate Designs button present at bottom
critical_code_review_comments: Instagram tab correctly force-reloads talents on entry (AdminDashboard.jsx line 171: condition !== 'instagram' and case 'instagram' calls fetchAllTalents)
VERIFIED TALENT badge fully removed from JSX (no occurrences in file)
Custom images support properly wired: imageSource uses customImages array when useCustomImages=true (lines 952-954, 1014-1016)

Minor: When 'Use Custom Images' is ON with zero uploaded images, design previews show broken image (undefined src). Consider disabling Generate button or showing warning when useCustomImages && customImages.length < 2
File size is very large (~1600+ lines) - consider splitting AdminDashboard into smaller tab-component files for maintainability
